body: @babygau can you give me more details about how to reproduce this? Your `init.vim` and the markdown file that caused the crash would be nice.
Since I have no way of reproducing or debugging locally, moving to 0.2

@tarruda 

Can you pls test this markdown file [test.md](https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/65699467/test.md). I doubt it's because the file is quite big.
I can open this file normally. Do you always get a crash when you open that file? If so, could you please post your init.vim(old nvimrc)?

I'm experiencing the same issue with the following file and init.vim:

file: https://gist.github.com/jesuspc/fa011fabafc20dcafdd7
init.vim: https://gist.github.com/jesuspc/fdaa9186f880eaf63ba9

It works again if I comment lines 78, 106 (both set filetype indent plugin on) and 83 (vim-rails) of the init.vim
In order to help others diagnose the issue, it is always advised to create a _minimal_ init.vim file.

@brcolow the minimal init.vim would contain a single line:

``` vimscript
filetype indent plugin on
```

This is happening to me even with a minimal init.vim mentioned above.

my init.vim is only `filetype indent plugin on` with OSX 10.10.5 with neovim 0.1.5 installed through homebrew.

Not all markdown files do it.  I can create simple markdown files, save them, close nvim and open it back up just fine.

Opening up one of the crashing files (which was originally created using neovim) gives the following error: 

```
"exercise1-2.md" 71L, 9164CAssertion failed: (!stream->closed), function stream_close, file /tmp/neovim/20160919044534019k0rg/neovim-0.1.5/src/nvim/event/stream.c, line 78.
[1] 3567 abort nvim exercise1-2.md
```

This leaves behind a swap file when I try to load the file again, which getting by leads to another crash. 

Oddly I can load the file in restricted mode (`nvim -Z`).  

Running `nvim -D` doesn't give me any additional information.  

Running nvim -r to recover a crashed session (which causes my mouse to die in iterm2, so I can't cut/paste):
![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/6800365/18980596/c8fb43e0-868a-11e6-8a66-f5a34d778b89.png)

An example [markdown file that crashes can be found here](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apiaryio/api-blueprint/master/examples/Polls%20Hypermedia%20API.md)
I'm having the same issue with a `README.md`.
For me, the issue was caused by this plugin: 'suan/vim-instant-markdown'.
